target_customer: Office managers and employers in US offices who buy a freezer and kiosk to give employees smoothies
problem: Office workers want fresh healthy drinks, but juice bars are off site and existing office juicers are expensive and slow to sell.
business_model: Hardware kiosk placed in offices plus recurring sales of consumable pods at $2.99 each, with a stated 56% margin per the YC page
product_category: Food tech, office pod based smoothie kiosk

founders.name: Oliver Takach
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder and names Careledger (YC S15) and Retriever as earlier ventures. No education or employers on the page.

competitors.name: Juicero
competitors.what: Connected countertop juicer with subscription juice packs
competitors.traction_then: The YC description calls out slow demand for its expensive machine and subscriptions

competitors.name: Replenish (formerly LivBlends)
competitors.what: YC backed smoothie startup selling to small and mid sized offices
competitors.traction_then: Early office clients including Uber per the company founder coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: A kiosk that blends a frozen pod silently in 30 seconds needs custom hardware, a cold chain for pods and reliable cleaning, but a two person team could assemble a pilot. The YC page reports about $30,000 monthly recurring revenue, so a working unit existed.

defensibility.rationale: Pods and kiosks could be copied by other food and beverage players. The only stated edge was pod price and the office commerce wedge, with no patents or data cited.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent copying or buying Origin. Replenish and Juicero were already selling into offices at founding.

market_need_then: The YC page cites 188,000 US offices as the target and states $30,000 monthly recurring revenue, a 56% margin on $2.99 pods and 7 week kiosk payback, all company claims at Demo Day time. Juicero slow demand showed price sensitivity.

branding.domain_note: Used eatorigin.com, not an exact match .com, and the domain no longer resolves from this session.

identity.logo: A plain letter O per a search summary, not verified on a source page

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found. The name is shared with many other companies, such as Origin Almond and Origin Materials.

outcome_analysis: Origin joined YC in Winter 2017 with a pod based office smoothie kiosk and claimed $30,000 monthly recurring revenue with fast weekly growth. The YC directory now lists it as inactive, but no shutdown announcement, post mortem or news coverage was found, so the cause is not public. Failure factors stay empty for that reason, and any story about hardware cost or office churn would be a guess.
notes: Company site eatorigin.com did not resolve (DNS failure) so it is treated as dead or unreachable. Seed of 120000 in 2017-03 rests on CB Insights and BounceWatch, both databases, and is the standard YC amount; BounceWatch also names Pareto Holdings and Jon Oringer as participants, unverified. Other Origin seed rounds on aggregators (2016, 2019, 2022) belong to different companies. Directory status is Inactive; exit type is unknown because no source gives the end of operations.
